column1: # Workflow WRITER filesystem policy (A3 — bounded journal I/O off the VM thread).
# Journal `write_all` / `fs::write` calls MUST live on the per-run writer thread
# (`writer.rs`). The approval protocol is the one separately reviewed exception:
# `approval.rs` is invoked either from a host CLI command or through
# `PreparedExternalOperation::quarantined_blocking`, never directly from a VM quantum,
# and publishes one bounded sidecar with a hard cleanup deadline. Exact file/count rows
# make any new synchronous workflow write fail review. The scan comment-strips and counts
# the production module only (the #[cfg(test)] block is never shipped).
